verdict.rationale: The official JS SDK README documents creating a meeting session in the client application, and points to a self-contained serverless meeting demo. That supports the client-connect part of the flow. Nothing in the pack shows server-side meeting creation, minting a scoped attendee join token, or a short end-to-end quickstart tying these steps together. Missing for 10: server-side session/meeting creation API evidence, scoped join-token (attendee credential) minting, a documented short end-to-end setup flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a session from my server, mint a scoped join token, and connect a client with the official SDK in a short documented flow

citations.quote: Create a meeting session in your client application.
